title: Tuning the magnetic properties of sandwiched hexaferrite/cobalt ferrite exchange-coupled nanocomposites obtained in high-boiling organic solvent
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32758-32767
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04855A, Paper

Roy Nygaard, Aleksandr N. Vasiliev, Jianing Chen, Evgeny O. Anokhin, Ekaterina S. Kozlyakova, Maria S. Kondratyeva, Svetlana V. Trusova, Evgeny A. Gorbachev, Lev A. Trusov
Thermolysis of metal acetylacetonates in a high-boiling solvent with hexaferrite nanoparticles yields sandwiched hexaferrite/CoFe2O4 nanocomposites with controlled layer thickness, efficient exchange coupling, and tunable magnetic properties.
